_about: Frozen copy of the teacher's corrections on the training stories as exact edits on the story text (v2 pipeline step 5, chinese_writing_rag_pipeline_v2/data/05_align/edits_train.jsonl), with HanLP's words at the edit (v2 step 4 parse) -- read by chunk_builder.py and mine_triggers.py. Positions index basic_corpus.json raw_text (identical texts). ops: replace / delete / insert = an error edit; comment = a note on a place with no text change; unplaceable = could not be located.
